# RNAstructure 6.6 vendored source

`RNAstructureSource.zip` is the official RNAstructure 6.6 source archive used
to build the in-process CPython extension. Its required SHA-256 is:

`4e30fa06f10a89556ad070c8d141fff6090165c330df786e19f9627df4407fd4`

The upstream program and the compiled extension are distributed under GNU GPL
version 2. `COPYING` is the upstream license text copied from `gpl.txt` in that
archive. The application distributes the exact corresponding source archive,
the custom wrapper source in `native/`, and deterministic build instructions.

No RNAstructure command-line executables are linked, bundled, or launched.
